the shear deformation of Ti6AlV4 alloy is localized and affected by the shear compressive proportion and the microstructural changes are related with DRX and twining grain formations, dislocation migration and stacking and grain refinement processes.

The shear deformation localization is significantly affected by the complex loadings, the ASB formation is related to the SCLP.

the micro-mechanics of shear deformation localization of the titanium alloy Ti6Al4v, and the results will be useful for the design and application of titanium alloy materials.
the micro-mechanics of SDL of Ti6AlV4 alloy under the complex loading condition, which is of great significance for the design of the Ti6AlV alloy in the engineering field.
the micro-mechanics of ASB formation and fracture failure of Ti6AlV alloy under the shear compressive loading conditions.
